checks.root_repairs: Repaired the malformed radical expression, repinned the executable checker to canonical Item 395, regenerated all certificate outputs, and canonicalized the replay path. No theorem or constant changed.

mathematical_audit.aggregate: The resultant with G_D is exactly the product over roots q and shifts d of (q-2d)(q+2d), hence the product of all positive endpoint norms.
mathematical_audit.valuation: The tied-interval inequalities force every candidate-prime divisibility q plus or minus 2d to be the equality p. The companion factor is a p-unit, so each neighboring root contributes exactly one valuation and v_p(A) equals graph degree.
mathematical_audit.degree: Modulo 3, a nonmultiple d permits at most one of p plus or minus 2d to remain prime, while a multiple permits at most two. This gives degree at most D+floor(D/3), strictly below 2D.
mathematical_audit.near_power: Dividing by R^(2D) produces the product of 1-4d^2/q^2. The logarithmic inequality, tied-prime count, and sum of squares give leading coefficient c^3/8 times log^2(M)/M.
mathematical_audit.subtraction: At every candidate prime, A has valuation degree below the 2D valuation of R^(2D). The ultrametric equality for unequal valuations therefore gives the same degree valuation in B=R^(2D)-A; no collision content cancels.
mathematical_audit.scope: The remaining integer height is potentially M log M, so aggregation, near-power subtraction, and graph-degree allocation alone do not meet Item 395's linear admission threshold. Gate-specific vertex-mass or carrier arithmetic remains open.
